required.bound: boolean: the identity root is sealed under a seven-word phrase
required.refresh_due: boolean: a phrase refresh is owed, independently of bound

reply.source: exactly the three keys of the aumlok object in the pinned organs reply; any other key or type refuses. The face also accepts the containing organs.reply body with its seven frozen sibling keys
reply.owner_origin: read only from the sibling of aumlok in organs.reply: 1..2048 UTF-8 bytes. Validated as https (or loopback http) origin form, never used by the face to create a frame or select a destination

screen.layout: Spatial surface/canvas/hero/composition markup: phrase language and read-only handle slots above the WORD 1 anchor and two numbered rows in each ROOT, UNITE and RISE band
screen.bound: tiles filled with dots; the words are never shown
screen.unavailable: an unavailable badge and no bound claim; a failed read removes the last good status
screen.handle: The public status does not include a handle. The read-only slot remains empty and states that the handle is unavailable; it accepts no text
screen.phrase_language: The public status does not include a phrase language. The disabled selector names it unavailable without claiming a language

panes: Sign in and phrase controls request a versioned navigation from the shell. Only the shell creates the trusted owner-origin frame after validating the exact request shape and installed AUMLOK frame source; this face collects no phrase or credential
phrase_strength: 41.5 bits minimum, 43.1 average, the shipped lists; never more

navigation.target: The shell origin from the frame referrer; no wildcard
